texts.zh:
拆除发电机区的导管套管后，发现了一些原始图纸中没有显示的东西：一段三米长的结构主梁，出现了严重的疲劳断裂。材料测定表明，这种损坏已经存在了几十年，但一直未被发现。

扩大施工范围以解决损坏问题将需要额外的时间。
texts.en:
Removal of conduit casings in the generator district revealed something none of the original schematics showed: a three-meter section of structural spine exhibiting advanced fatigue fracturing. Material dating suggests the damage has been present, undetected, for decades.

Expanding the scope of construction to address the damage will take additional time.

label.zh: 记录下来，然后按原计划进行。
label.en: Document it and proceed as planned.

label.zh: 扩大翻修范围。将这处断裂处妥善处理。
label.en: Expand the scope. Address it properly.
